milestones.title: 1.0.0 Governed qualification
milestones.description: Release the reproducible synthetic qualification, sourcing and data-product increment.

milestones.title: 1.1 Reviewer reliability
milestones.description: Improve reviewer handoff and validate operational boundaries for a pilot.

milestones.title: 2.0 Federated rollout
milestones.description: Admit a governed source and execute controlled warehouse delivery after pilot approval.

items.title: Record independent qualification gates
items.user: Buying needs comparable, accountable decisions before using a candidate.
items.value: Blocks uncontrolled awards and prevents informal sign-off.
acceptance: Buyer submits a profile and cannot approve.
Four approvals qualify routine risk; Legal is the fifth gate at high risk.
A return closes the cycle and a resubmission starts a fresh one.
Concurrent decisions on the same revision produce a single write.

items.title: Hold a supplier when evidence or incidents fail policy
items.user: Quality needs an expired certificate or critical issue to stop downstream selection.
items.value: Separates historical approval from current eligibility.
acceptance: Expired evidence blocks approval and publication.
A critical incident suspends qualification and is assigned to the responsible function.
Closing the incident leaves the supplier held until a new review completes.

items.title: Reconcile source identities with a governed crosswalk
items.user: The steward needs to reconcile source duplicates without silently merging suppliers.
items.value: Establishes a reusable identity and provenance record.
acceptance: Reordering an identical v1 snapshot does not duplicate its batch.
A matching registration links only on steward approval.
A name match alone cannot be linked or duplicated; changes to mapped legal identity are blocked.

items.title: Gate commercial award on qualification and contract
items.user: Procurement needs to see candidate supply before committing a qualified supplier.
items.value: Improves coordination without exposing an unqualified award path.
acceptance: The pipeline follows discovery → qualification → commercial → award.
Only Legal activates a contract; Procurement awards only with an effective agreement and a qualified supplier.

items.title: Publish Qualified Suppliers v1.0
items.user: Finance and Analytics need a minimal, stable master extract for reporting.
items.value: Moves eligibility decisions out of consumer spreadsheets.
acceptance: Approved, evidence-current suppliers are exported once per stable ID.
The response validates against v1.0 and withholds registration, source IDs and decision notes.

items.title: Explain supplier performance with weighted observations
items.user: Operations needs defensible performance comparisons and visible sample sizes.
items.value: Creates comparable decisions and a credible reuse path for Analytics.
acceptance: Rates divide summed counts across three completed months.
Composite is unavailable when any denominator is too small.
The projected SQL mart passes DQ and agrees with the service on the synthetic inputs.

items.title: Escalate aging review gates
items.user: Buying needs to follow up when cases exceed the agreed service window.
items.value: Targets lead time after the baseline is observed.
acceptance: Agree a shared calendar and ownership policy across regions.
A retry neither duplicates an escalation nor advances a closed case.

items.title: Evaluate identity provider and decision delegation
items.user: Reviewers need authenticated, traceable delegation before an internal pilot.
items.value: Tests the rationale and guardrails for real identity before delivery.
acceptance: Timebox to three working days; document role claims, reviewer delegation and access boundary.
Demonstrate isolated synthetic tests for revoked access and capture a go/no-go decision.

items.title: Validate Snowflake load, rollback and consumer roles
items.user: Analytics needs an agreed execution and run-cost plan before relying on Snowflake.
items.value: Reduces deployment uncertainty after the contract is stable.
acceptance: Timebox to three working days after credentials and isolated warehouse are approved.
Run load, rollback, least-privilege consumer query and parity tests; capture query IDs, elapsed time and spend for review.

items.title: Admit a bounded ERP supplier projection
items.owner: Source owner and Procurement Data owner
items.user: The steward needs a recurring supplier feed with known ownership and controlled change.
items.value: Reduces reconciliation overhead after the operating controls are established.
acceptance: Approve field mapping, source owner and cutover plan before switching on reads.
Demonstrate replay, quarantine, freshness alerts and one consumer acceptance in isolation.
